normative_extracts.quote: The user agent captures the old state as static images, runs the update callback, captures the live new state, and animates a pseudo-element tree between them.

browser_support.notes: Same-document document.startViewTransition() is Baseline Newly Available. Cross-document @view-transition remains Chromium/Safari.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Engine pauses rendering briefly to capture old textures, executes DOM mutation, then animates ::view-transition-old/new pairs.

production_failures.symptom: ViewTransition rejects with InvalidStateError or skips animation
production_failures.root_cause: Two elements share the same active view-transition-name simultaneously in the DOM.
production_failures.mitigation: Ensure every active view-transition-name is unique at snapshot time, or assign names dynamically before startViewTransition().

production_failures.symptom: Page feels frozen while waiting for data inside startViewTransition()
production_failures.root_cause: Awaiting a slow network fetch inside the startViewTransition callback blocks rendering until the promise resolves.
production_failures.mitigation: Fetch data first, then call document.startViewTransition() around the synchronous DOM swap.
